program: Master Son (section Son) - Diplome de l'ENS Louis-Lumiere
qualification: Diplome de l'Ecole nationale superieure Louis-Lumiere, specialite Son - 'Diplome de niveau Bac+5 qui confere le grade de Master' (RNCP 41626)
accreditationStatus: State school (grand etablissement) under the Ministry of Higher Education/Culture; diploma CONFERS THE GRADE DE MASTER (not a diplome national de master). RNCP level 7, fiche 41626.
institutionType: Public national school (ecole nationale superieure), outside the university frais-differencies regime
language: French (site states 'Anglais tout au long du cursus' as a taught language component; teaching is in French). DELF B2 French test required for non-francophones.
durationEcts: 3 years full-time (entry at Bac+2 level, exit at Bac+5). ECTS not published; grade de master at exit.
whatYouStudy: Acoustics, electroacoustics, signal processing, applied electronics; recording, editing and mixing on professional systems (Avid, Merging Technologies); three specialisation strands - sound for image (film/audiovisual), sound arts, and sound engineering (concert/live). Projects include music production, radio fiction, cinema collaborations and installations. 16 students per year per Master.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: 'Age 27 ans maximum'; 'Bac +2 minimum (2 ans d'etudes superieures dans la meme formation)'. Registration page: baccalaureat or equivalent required; alternative routes = 2 validated years of higher education in the same state-recognised programme, OR an RNCP level 5 professional certification. Foreign diplomas need sworn French translation and equivalency documents. Non-francophone applicants must supply 'copie d'un test officiel de francais equivalent au niveau DELF B2'.
acceptsNonMusic: YES in principle - no music degree or conservatoire training is required. QUOTE: 'Bac +2 minimum (2 ans d'etudes superieures dans la meme formation)' is the only academic condition, and the entrance concours is scientific/technical (acoustics, physics, maths) rather than musical. BUT the hard barrier is the age cap, QUOTE: 'Age 27 ans maximum'. NOTE: a BSc Software Engineering satisfies the diploma condition outright.
portfolioSpec: UNVERIFIED - no portfolio/demo requirement is published on the Son admissions pages; selection is by written concours + orals. The 'Livret du concours' PDF (https://www.ens-louis-lumiere.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Livret-concours-2025.pdf) holds the exact test list; not fully parsed here.
auditionSpec: NO performance audition. Entrance is by competitive examination ('sur concours (une fois par an)') with written scientific/technical papers plus oral interview - i.e. an academic concours, not a production test and not a musical audition. Exact Son test breakdown UNVERIFIED.
tuitionNonEU: ~€300/yr ('frais de scolarite autour de 300 €/an sauf statut boursier'). NOT subject to the university frais differencies (decret 2026-385) because ENS Louis-Lumiere is not a university under that regime.
otherFees: CVEC ~€104/yr; concours registration fee €120 (€60 for CROUS scholarship holders).
scholarshipName: CROUS bourses sur criteres sociaux (French residency conditions apply); Campus France / Eiffel and Tunisian government scholarships are the realistic routes.
scholarships: No school-specific scholarship published. Non-EU applicants normally rely on Bourse du gouvernement francais (BGF), Eiffel (rarely open to art schools), or Tunisian MESRS mobility grants. UNVERIFIED whether ENS Louis-Lumiere nominates for Eiffel.
languageRequirement: DELF B2 French minimum for non-francophones (official test copy required at concours registration).
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE: concours 2026 registration ran 1 December 2025 (15h) to 14 January 2026 (15h), fee payment by 21 January 2026. Expect the equivalent window ~1 Dec 2026 - mid Jan 2027 for a September 2027 intake. 2027 dates UNVERIFIED (not yet published).
applicationOpens: ~1 December 2026 (expected, by analogy with the 2026 cycle). UNVERIFIED.
notes: Strong fit on subject and cost (~€300/yr, Ministry-school, outside the €3,941 regime) but three hard filters: age <=27, a scientific concours in French, and only 16 seats. Recording/music production is one strand among film sound and live sound. He must also clear Campus France 'Etudes en France' (opens 1 Oct 2026, masters close ~15 Jan 2027) which collides with the concours window.

institution: ENSATT - Ecole Nationale Superieure des Arts et Techniques du Theatre
program: Diplome Arts et Techniques du Theatre - parcours Conception son (Concepteur son)
qualification: 'Diplome Arts et Techniques du Theatre conferant grade Master' - RNCP level 7 (fiche RNCP26985)
accreditationStatus: Ministry of Culture school (etablissement public sous tutelle du ministere de la Culture). Diploma CONFERS THE GRADE DE MASTER; it is NOT a diplome national de master.
institutionType: Public national school under the Ministry of Culture - outside the university frais-differencies regime
durationEcts: 3 years (Bac+2 entry to Bac+5 exit). ECTS not published on the page - UNVERIFIED.
whatYouStudy: Sound design and sound direction for live performance/theatre: sound conception, system design, recording, mixing and live operation, composition and montage for stage, work in ENSATT's production seasons alongside directors, actors, lighting and set designers. This is THEATRE sound craft, not record production - no discographic/mixing-for-release track.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: 'Accessible sur concours a partir de Bac + 2'.
acceptsNonMusic: YES on paper - the only academic condition is Bac+2, with no music or conservatoire diploma required. QUOTE: 'Accessible sur concours a partir de Bac + 2'. In practice the concours includes an artistic portfolio ('dossier artistique') that a candidate with no work would fail.
portfolioSpec: 'Dossier artistique' required, submitted by the concours deadline (deadline shown on the school site as 2 March 2027 for that cycle). Exact contents - number of pieces, durations, formats - UNVERIFIED; ENSATT publishes a per-parcours 'fiche concours' PDF each November that specifies them.
auditionSpec: PRACTICAL/ARTISTIC concours, not a performance audition: artistic dossier, then two admissibility jury phases (dates published as 18 March and 7 April 2027) then an interview (8 April 2027). Practical sound tests are part of the parcours son concours - exact form UNVERIFIED.
tuitionNonEU: €500/yr registration (2026/2027 published rate). Ministry of Culture school - NOT subject to the €3,941 frais differencies.
otherFees: Student life & campus contribution €105; concours entry fee €95. Continuing-professional-education version of the same training (FPC, 10 months) costs €9,000 TTC - avoid, it is not the student route.
scholarshipName: CROUS bourses; Ministry of Culture aid for students of its schools.
scholarships: UNVERIFIED - ENSATT students are eligible for CROUS bourses sur criteres sociaux under the usual conditions; no dedicated international scholarship found.
languageRequirement: French - level not published on the parcours page; the whole training and concours are in French. UNVERIFIED exact level.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE: registration for the SON parcours ran 6 January 2026 (12h) to 3 February 2026 (12h). The site also shows a later cycle with artistic dossier due 2 March 2027 and jury 18 March / 7 April 2027, interview 8 April 2027.
applicationOpens: ~early January (by analogy: 6 January in the 2026 cycle).
notes: Cheap and prestigious, grade de master, but the craft is theatre sound design - it does not train record producers/mix engineers. Also French-only and portfolio-gated.

institution: Universite de Bretagne Occidentale (UBO) - UFR Sciences et Techniques
program: Master Ingenierie de l'image, ingenierie du son - parcours Image et Son
qualification: Diplome national de master (DNM) - mention 'Ingenierie de l'image, ingenierie du son'
accreditationStatus: DIPLOME NATIONAL DE MASTER, state-accredited. Onisep/Mon Master confirm Brest is the only French university carrying this mention.
institutionType: Public university - subject to the frais differencies regime
whatYouStudy: Acoustics, optics, audiovisual signal acquisition and processing; microphones, loudspeakers, room acoustics, digital signal treatment for image/video/audio, cinema production, MUSIC STUDIO WORK, perception of sound and vision; practical projects producing a short film or a music recording. The course page describes graduates putting technical skills at the service of artistic projects 'such as a discographic recording or concert sound reinforcement'.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM (M1): 'recrutement post-L3 mention SPI parcours Image & Son ou equivalent' - selection on dossier plus interview. M2: continuation from M1 or an equivalent master year.
acceptsNonMusic: YES for a science/engineering bachelor, NO music degree needed - but the wording privileges the matching L3. QUOTE: 'recrutement post-L3 mention SPI parcours Image & Son ou equivalent'. A BSc Software Engineering would be argued as 'equivalent' (SPI = Sciences pour l'ingenieur); this is a judgement call by the jury - VERIFY DIRECTLY.
portfolioSpec: No portfolio published as a requirement. Selection is dossier + entretien. UNVERIFIED whether a demo helps.
auditionSpec: NO audition. Dossier + interview only (no performance audition, no published practical production test).
tuitionNonEU: €3,941/yr master differentiated fee (frais differencies) for non-EU/EEA students, per decret n°2026-385 of 19 May 2026, default from Sept 2026; discretionary exemptions capped at 30% of non-EU students in 2026-27 and 25% in 2027-28 (his entry year). Plus CVEC ~€105/yr. Confirmed on Legifrance JORFTEXT000054113646 / MESR FAQ.
totalCostEstimate: ~€4,050/yr fees if not exempted; ~€280/yr if exempted (standard master rate). Brest living costs are among the lowest in France (~€700-900/month).
scholarshipName: Exoneration des droits differencies (institutional, quota-capped); Bourse du gouvernement francais (BGF); Eiffel.
scholarships: UBO operates a partial/total exoneration commission for non-EU students, now capped by decret 2026-385 at 25% of non-EU enrolments in 2027-28. Specific UBO policy for 2027 UNVERIFIED.
languageRequirement: French required (teaching in French). Level not stated on the parcours page - UNVERIFIED; UBO normally asks B2/C1 for non-francophones.
deadline: M1 via monmaster.gouv.fr (national calendar, typically late Feb - late March). NOTE: as a Tunisian resident he does NOT use Mon Master - he must go through Campus France Tunisie 'Etudes en France': opens 1 October 2026, master applications close ~15 January 2027.
applicationOpens: Campus France Etudes en France: 1 October 2026.
notes: BEST STRUCTURAL FIT among French DNMs for a software-engineering graduate who wants studio work: it is a science-based master that explicitly includes music studio production and discographic recording, and it is the only French master with the 'ingenierie du son' mention. Weak point: French-language, and it is engineering-led rather than creative record production.

institution: Aix-Marseille Universite (AMU) - Faculte des Sciences + UFR ALLSH
program: Master Acoustique et Musicologie - parcours Ingenierie et Conception Sonore (ICS)
qualification: Diplome national de master (DNM) - mention 'Acoustique et musicologie'
institutionType: Public university - subject to the frais differencies regime
language: French (C1 for non-francophone international students); English B2 also required.
durationEcts: 2 years, 120 ECTS (30 ECTS/semester). 5-month internship in the final semester + research dissertation in S4.

acceptsNonMusic: YES, explicitly - a computer-science bachelor is a named recommended background. QUOTE (from the AMU Sciences page): recommended backgrounds include 'physics, mathematics, computer science, mechanics, engineering sciences' with 'musical competency desired' (not required).
auditionSpec: NO audition and no published practical production test - selection on dossier via the national platform.
tuitionNonEU: €3,941/yr master differentiated fee (frais differencies) for non-EU/EEA students, per decret n°2026-385 of 19 May 2026, default from Sept 2026; discretionary exemptions capped at 30% of non-EU students in 2026-27 and 25% in 2027-28 (his entry year). Plus CVEC ~€105/yr. Confirmed on Legifrance JORFTEXT000054113646 / MESR FAQ.
totalCostEstimate: ~€4,050/yr fees if not exempted; Marseille living ~€800-1,000/month.
scholarshipName: AMU exoneration commission; BGF; Eiffel (AMU nominates).
scholarships: UNVERIFIED for 2027-28; AMU historically exonerated a large share of non-EU students - that is now capped at 25% for 2027-28.
languageRequirement: French C1 minimum for non-francophone international students (unless holding a French university degree); English B2 minimum.
englishTest: English B2 required - accepted certificates UNVERIFIED.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE reference: applications 1 March - 3 April, admission decisions 19 June - 17 July, enrolment by 20 July (2023 calendar published on the page). For 2027 he goes through Campus France Tunisie Etudes en France instead: opens 1 Oct 2026, masters close ~15 Jan 2027.
applicationOpens: Campus France Etudes en France: 1 October 2026.
notes: Most CS-friendly French DNM on paper, and no audition/portfolio. But it is acoustics/sound engineering and research-led - it will not by itself make him a record producer. French C1 is a real barrier only if his French is not already strong (it is: he is fluent).

program: Master Cinema et Audiovisuel - parcours Ingenierie du son a l'image
qualification: Diplome national de master (DNM) - mention 'Cinema et audiovisuel'
institutionType: Public university - subject to the frais differencies regime
language: French - 'C1 French level required for international students'.
durationEcts: 2 years; page states M1 = 120 ECTS cumulative and M2 = 240 ECTS cumulative (i.e. 60 ECTS per year on top of the licence).
whatYouStudy: Sound for image: sound capture, editing, mixing and completion of the audiovisual production chain; projects on fiction shorts (3-15 min), documentaries (12-26 min) and multicamera capture. Film/TV sound post-production, not music record production.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: M1 - 'Licence, 180 ECTS et 4 semaines de stage dans le secteur'. M2 - 'M1 Cinema et Audiovisuel, 240 ECTS et 8 semaines de stage dans le secteur'. Mandatory professional project with at least one month of audiovisual internship experience; recommended strong audiovisual industry knowledge, film culture, computer skills and a driving licence.
acceptsNonMusic: YES for the degree, NO for the experience. QUOTE: 'Licence, 180 ECTS et 4 semaines de stage dans le secteur' - any licence qualifies academically, but four weeks of documented sector internship is a hard gate that a candidate with no professional audio experience does not currently meet.
portfolioSpec: None published as such; instead a documented 'projet professionnel' plus proof of a minimum one-month audiovisual internship.
auditionSpec: PRACTICAL SELECTION, not a musical audition: 'Recrutement en master s'effectue sur dossier, QCM et entretien' - dossier + multiple-choice test + interview.
tuitionNonEU: €3,941/yr master differentiated fee (frais differencies) for non-EU/EEA students, per decret n°2026-385 of 19 May 2026, default from Sept 2026; discretionary exemptions capped at 30% of non-EU students in 2026-27 and 25% in 2027-28 (his entry year). Plus CVEC ~€105/yr. Confirmed on Legifrance JORFTEXT000054113646 / MESR FAQ.
deadline: Pre-registration deadline given as 'early April' on the faculty page (PRIOR CYCLE). For him: Campus France Etudes en France, opens 1 Oct 2026, closes ~15 Jan 2027.
notes: Film-sound, not records. The 4-week sector internship prerequisite effectively rules him out for Sept 2027 unless he gets studio/audiovisual placement in Tunisia beforehand.

qualification: Diplome national de master (DNM) - mention 'Audiovisuel, medias interactifs numeriques, jeux'

acceptsNonMusic: YES, explicitly - computing is a named accepted background. QUOTE: applicants holding a Licence or equivalent (180 ECTS) in 'audiovisual, telecommunications, applied physics, computing or multimedia' fields are considered 'sur dossier et entretien'.
tuitionNonEU: €3,941/yr master differentiated fee (frais differencies) for non-EU/EEA students, per decret n°2026-385 of 19 May 2026, default from Sept 2026; discretionary exemptions capped at 30% of non-EU students in 2026-27 and 25% in 2027-28 (his entry year). totalCostEstimate: ~€4,050/yr fees if not exempted; Valenciennes is a low-cost city.

city: Lyon (Universite Lumiere Lyon 2, dept musique/musicologie, 3 rue Rachais)
program: Master Musicologie - parcours MAAAV (Musiques Appliquees aux Arts Visuels)
institutionType: Public university - subject to the frais differencies regime
durationEcts: 2 years, 120 ECTS. 16 places in M1 per year.
whatYouStudy: Composing and producing music for image - film scoring, sound design/habillage sonore, orchestration, studio realisation and mixing of the score, international scoring competitions. Recruitment only into M1.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: 'Le recrutement s'effectue sur concours uniquement en master 1 : 16 places disponibles chaque annee - en formation initiale : a l'issue d'une licence (quelle qu'elle soit) - en reprise d'etudes a certaines conditions : sur presentation d'une licence, ou dans le cadre de la VAPP... un minimum de 5 annees d'activites professionnelles dans le milieu musical sont exigees dans ce cas de figure'. Also VERBATIM: 'NB : Pas de limite d'age'; 'Le recrutement est international : 36 pays representes a ce jour'.
acceptsNonMusic: YES - stated outright. QUOTE: 'en formation initiale : a l'issue d'une licence (quelle qu'elle soit)' ('after a bachelor's degree, whichever it is'). No music degree required. HOWEVER the portfolio demands written scores, which requires notation skill.
portfolioSpec: EXACT, verbatim: '3 compositions personnelles recentes de styles varies sur 3 films courts : 3 fichiers son (fichiers wav ou mp3) montes sur 3 films courts (de 3 a 5 mn maxi) + 3 partitions obligatoires (format PDF) associees a ces 3 films. (musiques originales ou remises en musique de films existants)'. Plus: 'Au debut de chaque partition devra figurer un lien vers le film depose sur la chaine youtube personnelle (a creer)'; 'L'une des 3 pieces (au minimum) devra obligatoirement meler sound design (habillage sonore, bruitages) et musique instrumentale (et/ou vocale)'; plus a short description of the 3 pieces, a 'CV musical tres detaille' and a motivation letter. Whole dossier digital, PDF.
auditionSpec: PRACTICAL PRODUCTION TEST, not a performance audition. Two stages: (1) 'epreuve d'admissibilite' - a timed take-home scoring test, 'envoi du film a remettre en musique en temps limite (en 2 semaines)': an original composition on a 3-4 min short film mixing instrumental writing and sound design, delivered as PDF score + mp3 mixed to the film + a written justification of musical choices; (2) 'rencontre avec le jury de selection' - an interview with the selection jury.
tuitionNonEU: €3,941/yr master differentiated fee (frais differencies) for non-EU/EEA students, per decret n°2026-385 of 19 May 2026, default from Sept 2026; discretionary exemptions capped at 30% of non-EU students in 2026-27 and 25% in 2027-28 (his entry year). Plus CVEC ~€105/yr. Confirmed on Legifrance JORFTEXT000054113646 / MESR FAQ.
totalCostEstimate: ~€4,050/yr fees if not exempted; Lyon living ~€900-1,100/month.
languageRequirement: French - level not stated but the whole dossier, test and jury are in French. Foreign diplomas require sworn French translation ('traduction par traducteur assermente').
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE (2026): dossiers on monmaster 17 February - 16 March 2026; admissibility test 24 March - 7 April 2026; pre-selection jury 7 April - 15 May; selection jury 19 May 2026. Expect the same shape in 2027 - UNVERIFIED.
applicationOpens: ~17 February (2026 reference). For a Tunisian resident, Campus France Etudes en France opens 1 October 2026 and closes ~15 January 2027 - CHECK how the two calendars are reconciled; MAAAV names monmaster as the single platform, which does not serve Etudes en France candidates.
notes: ADJACENT to the field, not core: this is composition for image (film scoring), not record production/mixing/mastering. Included because it is the single most explicit 'any bachelor accepted' quote found in France and it is genuinely international. Blocking issue for this candidate: three finished scored films with PDF scores - he has no portfolio and cannot notate.

notes: Name promises more than the content delivers for a would-be record producer. Worth a look only if Paris-Saclay's IDEX scholarship turns out to cover it.

accreditationStatus: DIPLOME NATIONAL DE MASTER ('diplome controle par l'Etat').
institutionType: Public university - subject to the frais differencies regime
durationEcts: 2 years; 660 taught hours total (M1 363h, M2 297h). ECTS 120 (standard DNM) - not stated on the page.
whatYouStudy: Creation and re-creation approached either as research or as professional training - electroacoustic/computer music creation, sound creation, musicology of creation. This is closer to electroacoustic composition and sound creation than to record production, mixing or mastering.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: 'L'acces en M1 est autorise en cas d'obtention d'une licence (soit 180 ECTS) dans un champ compatible avec celui du diplome de master ou dans le meme domaine.' Eligible degrees named: Music/Musicology licence; Anthropology licence (with music-musicology prerequisites for ethnomusicology research); DNSPM or equivalent foreign qualification with musicology prerequisites for research-creation projects.
acceptsNonMusic: NO in practice. QUOTE: 'L'acces en M1 est autorise en cas d'obtention d'une licence (soit 180 ECTS) DANS UN CHAMP COMPATIBLE avec celui du diplome de master ou dans le meme domaine' - and the enumerated eligible degrees are all music/musicology/anthropology/DNSPM. A software-engineering BSc is not a 'champ compatible'.
portfolioSpec: Not specified on the programme page - UNVERIFIED.
tuitionNonEU: €3,941/yr master differentiated fee (frais differencies) for non-EU/EEA students, per decret n°2026-385 of 19 May 2026, default from Sept 2026; discretionary exemptions capped at 30% of non-EU students in 2026-27 and 25% in 2027-28 (his entry year). Plus CVEC ~€105/yr. Confirmed on Legifrance JORFTEXT000054113646 / MESR FAQ.
languageRequirement: French; the page mentions an annual language course but sets no explicit level - UNVERIFIED.
deadline: Not published on the programme page - UNVERIFIED. Campus France Etudes en France governs him: 1 Oct 2026 - ~15 Jan 2027.
notes: OUT OF SCOPE-ADJACENT: this sits in the electroacoustic-composition/sound-creation territory that another sweep owns. Recorded here only because Paris 8 was on the target list, and to state plainly that it does NOT accept a non-music bachelor.

institution: Le Fresnoy - Studio national des arts contemporains
program: Cursus / Diplome du Fresnoy (2-year post-graduate artist residency-school)
qualification: 'Diplome du Fresnoy - Studio national des arts contemporains'. Whether it formally confers the grade de master is UNVERIFIED on the official pages consulted; it is commonly described as a post-master artistic cursus.
accreditationStatus: Ministry of Culture establishment. NOT a diplome national de master. Grade-de-master status UNVERIFIED - do not assume.
institutionType: Public national school under the Ministry of Culture - outside the university frais-differencies regime
whatYouStudy: Production of audiovisual and digital artworks with professional technical means - film, video, photography, digital creation, installation, and sound as one medium among many. There is NO music production, mixing or mastering curriculum.
entryRequirements: Applicants of any background and nationality, 'no older than 35 on 1 January of the year of the process', holding the French baccalaureat or equivalent followed by five years of study attested by a diploma/certificate, OR equivalent professional artistic experience. Selection is on an artistic dossier of existing work plus an interview.
acceptsNonMusic: YES formally - 'welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of gender or nationality' - but it requires Bac+5 (he will only have Bac+3) and a substantial body of existing artistic work.
portfolioSpec: A substantial portfolio of completed artistic works plus a detailed production project for a new work to be made at Le Fresnoy. Exact file counts/durations UNVERIFIED.
auditionSpec: No audition. Portfolio review + interview with a jury of artists.
tuitionNonEU: €760/yr ('yearly attendance fees for the 2026-2027 term amount to 760 euros'). NOT subject to the €3,941 frais differencies. 'With the exception of registration fees, studies are free for all students.'
scholarshipName: Le Fresnoy production budget for each student's works (not a stipend).
scholarships: Each admitted student receives a production budget for their artworks. No tuition scholarship needed at €760/yr. UNVERIFIED whether any living stipend exists.
languageRequirement: UNVERIFIED - working languages French and English.
deadline: Annual call for applications, typically closing in the spring - exact 2027 dates UNVERIFIED.
notes: NOT A MUSIC-PRODUCTION PROGRAMME and requires Bac+5 plus an established artistic practice. Cheap and prestigious but structurally out of reach for this candidate in 2027. Included because it was on the target list; recommend dropping it.
